We are pleased to announce the launch of the redesigned EQUATOR Network
website. The new site is designed to help researchers, authors, editors,
peer reviewers and educators find the resources they need to improve the
quality and transparency of health research reporting, faster than ever.

Since its founding, the EQUATOR Network has been a trusted source for
reporting guidelines such as CONSORT, PRISMA and STROBE. As the library has
grown, so has the need for a site that makes it simple to navigate. The new
design puts users first, with clearer structure, improved search and a more
modern look.

**What's new:**

\- **Easier navigation:** A faster way to [search reporting
guidelines](/reporting-guidelines/index.qmd) and [research reporting guidelines under development](/reporting-guidelines/under-development/index.qmd)

\- **Refreshed toolkits** [authors](/toolkits/writing-research/index.qmd),
[journals](/toolkits/using-guidelines-in-journals/index.qmd), [peer
reviewers](/toolkits/peer-reviewing-research/index.qmd) and [reporting guideline developers](/toolkits/developing-a-reporting-guideline/index.qmd)

\- **Improved look:** a clean and modern feel to the website

## Feedback
